title: Rick Explains Neural Networks (Because You Asked!)
caption: Why does your phone recognize your face? #NeuralNetworks #AI

scenes.script: Alright, Morty, imagine the brain is like a Rube Goldberg machine. But for learning.
Uh, okay? So... what's the machine part?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: The neural network! It's layers of nodes, like tiny workers passing data. Each node does a little math.
Wait, so it's like when I tried to learn guitar? But with math?
Exactly! You feed it data—like labeled pictures of cats. It starts guessing wrong, but that's okay.
Why is that okay? That sounds like me in math class!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Because it uses backpropagation! It checks its mistakes, adjusts the weights—like tightening a screw.
scenes.web_image: diagram of backpropagation in neural networks

scenes.script: So it learns by being wrong? That sounds like my love life.
Yep! And that's why your phone recognizes you. It sees patterns, even if it’s just a blob of pixels.
Wait, so if I feed it my bad jokes, will it learn to be funnier?
Not likely, Morty. Neural networks are good at math, not comedy. But hey, if it could, I’d be out of a job.
So now you’re just jealous of a machine?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty evil with a serious looking and a portal gun.png

topic: How does a neural network learn from data?
